name: The Last Don
description: A match-3 game set on Fort Worth's Historic South Side. Match crowns, keys and fists to take Panther City back from the New Order, one block at a time.
details: Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or computer
District 1 is free to try; this unlocks districts 2 to 5

name: Rebel Elimination
description: Fort Worth is under siege. Run, gun and take down three bosses as Dontae Amare in this side-scrolling action game.
details: Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or computer
Three stages, three bosses, three difficulty settings
Stage 1 is free to try; this unlocks stages 2 and 3

name: Cosmic Encounter
description: A Galaga-style space shooter. Pick a ship, clear the waves, make your choices in the encounters, and take down the bosses.
details: Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or computer
Endless waves with a boss every fifth wave
Upgrades and story encounters between waves
Waves 1 to 5 and the first boss are free to try; this unlocks every wave after

name: ORI
description: A new kind of tile game. Master 18 five-block shapes across 30 levels and six zones, from rising rows to a hidden next piece.
details: Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or computer
30 levels in six zones, then endless ORBIT mode
Zone 1 (levels 1 to 5) is free to try; this unlocks zones 2 to 6 and ORBIT

name: All-Access Pass
description: Every paid game in the DARE Arcade, fully unlocked: The Last Don, Rebel Elimination, Cosmic Encounter and ORI. $14.96 if bought one by one.
details: Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or computer
Unlocks The Last Don, Rebel Elimination, Cosmic Encounter and ORI
One unlock code works on all your devices
